en.title: 5 Must-Watch Movies for Your 2026 Thanksgiving Binge
en.summary: As the aroma of turkey fills the air, don't forget to carve out time for some cinematic feasts. We've curated a list of compelling films released this past year, perfect for your cozy Thanksgiving weekend.
en.body:
Thanksgiving weekend offers a precious few days to unwind, reconnect, and, for many of us, dive headfirst into our favorite stories. While the allure of the cinema is undeniable, the comfort of home viewing remains a cherished tradition. This year, we're spotlighting a selection of films from the past twelve months that promise to enrich your holiday downtime, blending thrilling narratives with compelling performances.

## Cinematic Journeys for the Holiday Weekend

This year's cinematic landscape offers a rich tapestry of genres for every taste. For those craving a dose of historical drama with a twist, **By Any Means** teams up **Yahya Abdul-Mateen II** and **Mark Wahlberg** as an FBI agent and a mob hitman in 1966 Mississippi, investigating the murders of Civil Rights leaders. The film promises a gritty look at a pivotal era. On the more fantastical side, **Ebenezer** reimagines the classic Scrooge tale with a dark fantasy edge, featuring **Johnny Depp** and helmed by the director behind **X** and **Pearl**. It’s a perfect bridge from Thanksgiving to the Christmas season. For fans of biographical dramas, **Hershey** delves into the life of **Milton S. Hershey**, charting his rise to success through a journey filled with romance, heartbreak, and historical context.

For those who prefer their holiday viewing with a side of intense suspense, the thriller genre delivers. **Primetime** stars **Robert Pattinson** as a journalist reminiscent of Chris Hansen from *To Catch a Predator*, exploring the darker side of true crime. **Animals**, directed by and starring **Ben Affleck**, presents a high-stakes drama about a mayoral candidate and his wife fighting to rescue their kidnapped son. Meanwhile, **Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother** features **Mahershala Ali** as a devout hitman tasked with protecting his children after his wife’s passing. And for action aficionados, **Onslaught** sees **Adria Arjona** as an army sniper forced to protect her daughter from genetically-engineered soldiers, showcasing a blend of maternal instinct and elite combat skills.

## What's Captivating Audiences

The buzz around these films suggests a strong appetite for well-crafted narratives that resonate with both genre fans and newcomers. The inclusion of established stars like **Johnny Depp**, **Mahershala Ali**, and **Robert Pattinson** alongside compelling directorial visions from talents behind **X** and **Pearl** indicates a commitment to quality storytelling. These selections are not just movies; they are conversation starters, offering depth and excitement that extends beyond the holiday itself, appealing to those who appreciate the nuances of filmmaking and the power of a good story.

## What's Next

As you settle in for the holiday, explore these diverse cinematic offerings, available across various streaming platforms and for rent. Whether you're drawn to historical accuracy, thrilling suspense, or a touch of the fantastical, there's a film waiting to make your Thanksgiving weekend even more memorable.
